name: @rhombus-std/examples.lib.with-transformer
description: Example dependency library authored in the tokenless di dialect and built via the Go/ttsc engine. Its build is its only consumable form — every exports condition resolves to dist, so raw source never bypasses the transformer lowering.
//dependencies: di.core ONLY — never @rhombus-std/di. A library contributes registrations and takes its dependencies as parameters; the resolution engine belongs to the entrypoint packages that build a container. di.extras is a devDependency because it is the AUTHORING surface (declare-module sugar + inline bodies), not a runtime dependency, and it peers on di.core rather than on the engine; primitives.extras is likewise authoring-only (every tokenfor call folds to a string literal and its import is elided).
